kind: bug / Graph / sparse CSR / CPU kernel metadata
title: Graph mode CSRGather fails on CPU while PyNative returns gathered values
duplicate_search_queries: gh search issues '"Parsed metadata of op[CSRGather] failed" repo:mindspore-ai/mindspore'
duplicate_search_result: No exact matching GitHub or Gitee issue found.
documentation_notes: MindSpore 2.9 local ops.csr_gather docstring accepts indptr, indices, dense, and sparse_shape, returns a Tensor, and lists GPU and CPU as supported platforms.
The tested CSR metadata comes from x.to_csr() for a valid dense Tensor x; Graph-mode CSRTensor.to_tuple and COOTensor controls pass on the same input.
classification_notes: Not a numerical precision issue: the reproducer checks that Graph mode can return gathered values; it fails before returning.
Not an invalid CSR input issue: PyNative returns the gathered non-zero values with shape (3,), and CSR tuple controls pass in Graph mode.
Not a general sparse/COO issue: int64 COO concat/add controls pass in Graph mode in the same campaign.
The Graph error is localized to CSRGather CPU kernel metadata parsing: 'Parsed metadata of op[CSRGather] failed'.
